snippet.title: PETRACAL Reveal Trailer: DEMO OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Wishlist PETRACAL on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261440/PETRACAL/

PETRACAL is a first person dungeon-crawler survival set in the tunnels of a cave. Chart, plan, explore, devour, stay sane, and crawl your way to escape using everything you have at your hands reach to survive.

Our Website: https://www.feralsquid.com/
